industries.narrative: Broad 84% advance with strong +2.1% cap-weighted move; AI power/data-center beneficiaries (VRT, HUBB) and fuel cells (BE, PLUG) leading, but relvol soft.

sector_breadth_notes.note: Sector move is narrow: Electrical Equipment leads alone while Airlines, Consulting, and Building Products lag badly. AI-power/electrification theme, not broad industrial strength.
Financials qualify at sector level but no industry clears the gate. Regional Banks, Insurance Life/Specialty/Brokers all weak — sector strength is hollow at the industry layer.
Healthcare sector strength not confirmed by industries; Drug Manufacturers - General sits among worst laggards (20% advancing). No qualifying industry.
REITs failing breadth confirmation — Residential and Industrial REITs both deep laggards. Sector-level move appears mega-cap or rate-driven, not broad.

key_divergences: Major disconnect: 4 sectors flagged strong but only 1 industry (Electrical Equipment) confirms. XLF, XLV, XLRE strength is mega-cap concentrated; underlying industry breadth is broadly negative. Low relvol on the one leader also caveats conviction.
leadership_theme: AI-power/electrification narrow leadership; financials, healthcare, REITs hollow underneath
